The 2023 **Recreation Visits by Site Designation** table from the National Park Service shows that **three official site designations together make up more than 56 % of all recreation‑visits to the U.S. National Parks System**. Those categories are:

| Site Designation | % of Total 2023 Visits |
|-------------------|------------------------|
| **National Park** | ~29 % |
| **National Recreation Area** | ~15 % |
| **National Memorial** | ~11 % |

Adding the three percentages together (≈ 29 % + 15 % + 11 %) gives roughly **56%** of all visitors, confirming that these three designations are the main contributors to visitation totals in 2023.
